summary: Veraxa Biotech AG filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, attaching a press release about regulatory progress for its BiTAC-TCE program after receiving Scientific Advice from the German Paul-Ehrlich-Institute. No financial terms, transaction, or special-situation event such as mergers, tender offers, activist campaigns, or restructuring is involved. The filing reports routine business progress and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
